record.question: He _____________ shelter under a tree. Fill in the blank with the appropriate form of verb.
record.explanation: Answer C: takes. “Takes shelter” is the appropriate simple-present completion; “seek” would require the word “seeks” to agree with he. Independent check: The subject “he” takes “takes”; “take” would require a different subject. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-prepositions-and-prepositions-followed-by-ing-forms; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
